title: MeshSat Hub — multi-tenant SaaS management platform
youtrack_disambiguator: tag:hub OR summary contains 'hub' / 'galera' / 'tenant' — see ROUTING.md
deployment_tiers: Tier 2: Docker Compose cluster + Galera + NATS

parallel_dev_exception.workflow: merge/<feature_id> short-lived branch + 1 MR per feature + auto-delete branch on merge
parallel_dev_exception.rationale: Repo's default 'push to main' rule conflicts with parallel-dev. Override applies only to parallel-dev waves; human work continues push-to-main as before.

security_posture: internet-exposed; security is #1 priority above features
schema_migration_strategy: hand-rolled idempotent CREATE-IF-NOT-EXISTS + ALTER-IGNORE-DUPE; no schema_migrations table; MUST update BOTH sqlite/sqlite.go AND mariadb/mariadb.go per change
_bounded_contexts_note: 1:1 mapping with actual top-level directories. internal/* = 53 packages; non-internal = web/ + cmd/ + deploy/ + scripts/.
